    GL Lab guide

    Start with your code

    About GL Lab & getting startedعن المختبر وطريقة الاستخدام

    This workspace runs real C and C++ code in your browser. Start a new program or open your own single source file.

    1. Open your code. Use New for starter source or Open for an existing program. On small screens these are in the File menu.
    2. Edit the C/C++ source. Changes save automatically in this browser.
    3. Press Run. The build bar shows each step: loading the compiler, preparing graphics libraries, compiling and starting. Compiler errors appear in the console and are highlighted in the editor. Click the canvas before using keyboard or mouse controls.

    Graphics compatibility

    The Emscripten compiler runs on your device. Legacy OpenGL uses GL4ES to render through WebGL. GLUT and GLFW programs run with browser event loops. Read the compatibility guide for the supported paths and current limits.

    Compatibility and limitations

    Full desktop OpenGL, native operating-system APIs and arbitrary installed packages are unavailable. Programs must return control to the browser between frames. A blocking infinite loop can freeze the tab. The compiler is single-threaded and large programs may exceed device memory, especially on phones.

    Standard output (printf and std::cout) appears in the console. For scanf or cin, open Input in the console and enter the values before pressing Run. Input is supplied once per run; it is not an interactive terminal.

    Arrange your workspace

    Use Output and Console in the panel bar to hide or show each pane. Focus code hides both; select it again to restore your layout. Drag the dividers to resize panels, or focus a divider and use the arrow keys. Double-click a divider to reset its size. Reset layout restores both panes and their original sizes. Your layout stays in this browser. On phones, use the Editor, Output and Console tabs; the hide button returns to the editor.

    Separate output window

    Use the pop-out button above the canvas to open a live view in another tab or window. It mirrors the same running program and preserves its aspect ratio. Keyboard and mouse input work there too. Keep the editor tab open. The live view is limited to about 15 frames per second; the program continues at its own rate.

    Keep your work

    Your programs are saved in this browser. Download your source before clearing browser data or switching devices. Importing a file opens it as your personal program. Download and Copy mark the current source as backed up. When unbacked edits remain, the site requests a browser warning before closing or reloading. Browsers control that warning and may omit it, especially on mobile. Local drafts and the visible reminder provide additional protection. Your source is not uploaded to our server.

    Build options

    Emscripten compiles your source on this device. Graphics libraries are selected from your includes.

    For example, ["-O2"] enables optimization. The workspace supplies the output filename and runtime settings.

    Compiled build

    Downloads the last successful build. Keep its files together and load the generated module from a web page served over HTTP or HTTPS.
